notes_for_editor: Thin record: the sourced facts are the name, county, and the 1971 map label. The story is under the 120-word floor because I did not pad it. Record agency G has no key on the Forest Lookouts site, so it is unexplained; no replacement found. Record status and access are unknown. The Facebook post text was not readable beyond its title; a search snippet describes Long Prairie Fire Tower construction photos near Cloud in Delaware County, but that snippet is not page text, so I did not quote it. anyplaceamerica.com and newspapers.com returned 403. Pastmaps' description of the map is its own wording; the map label is the primary point.
